race.comment: KING KORUNA (10) wasn't beaten far first up at Sale when in the market, getting back in a slowly run race which didn't suit. He'd shown ability as a 2yo and should be better for the fresh  run under his belt. Drawn slightly better this time around and itr wouldn't surprise to see him improve sharply. WHITE POINTER (12) is a gelding by Spirit Of Boom on debut for the Hickmott yard. He's trialled well enough in South Australia and the stable are always worth watching with their newcomers. LITTLE GANGSTER (11) didn't fire on debut in a much tougher race in town before a solid fresh run here when third. Fitter now and has claims. GAMADALE PADDY (9) next best.
